% Files of the document read with the primitive \input inside each other:
% test-priminput/outer.tex reads test-priminput/inner.tex with the
% primitive \input, and then names itself like glossary.4ht with
% \ProvidesFile{glossary.tex}, after the inner file ends. As in the PDF,
% each file's text is in the page.
\documentclass{article}
\input test-priminput/outer
\begin{document}
Outer: \primouter\par
Inner: \priminner
\end{document}
